hooks.description: Approve writes to a wiki's own files (wiki/, raw/, SCHEMA.md, log.md, the manifest and configs) so one ingest doesn't prompt per page. Silent for every other path, and the user's deny rules still take precedence.
Regenerate wiki/index.md from page frontmatter. No-op if the current directory is not inside a wiki (no SCHEMA.md found).
Regenerate .manifest.json (source provenance: origin + sha256) from raw/ frontmatter. Derived like the index, so it can't drift. No-op outside a wiki.
Run deterministic mechanical lint (broken links, orphans, missing frontmatter). No-op outside a wiki. Deep/semantic lint is the wiki-lint skill, run on demand.
